commit_message: Run benchmark tasks in isolated Editor children
pr_title: GameEngine: add reproducible local LLM benchmark experiments
pr_body:
## Summary

Wires reproducible ADR0142 experiments into isolated real Editor child processes. Each child loads an exact model/task spec, uses the native read harness or governed AgentRun, bypasses multi-model routing for attribution, grants only fixed run-scoped runtime permissions, writes one machine-local result, and exits. ValidationRepair is structurally forced to observe an injected managed-validation failure before model repair and revalidation.

Next, the parent AI Studio controls/comparison view and task-specific runtime-interaction completion are finalized before validation.
